title: Home
description: Raw twelve-string guitar, uneasy fingerpicking and a lonely descending motif.
caption: Dark acoustic folk instrumental, intimate twelve-string steel-string guitar duet. A solitary fingerpicked guitar starts immediately with a memorable descending minor-key motif, ringing open strings, unsettling semitone suspensions and dissonant harmonics. A second lower guitar answers with sparse bass notes and imperfect arpeggios. Dry close-miked picks and string squeaks against a distant low ominous drone. Haunted medieval village at night, sorrowful, earthy, mysterious, old 1990s gothic dungeon-crawler soundtrack atmosphere. Restrained raw acoustic recording with shifting phrases, musical tension and audible space. Through-composed instrumental cue. A complete two minute evolving composition: an intimate opening, a contrasting quiet middle passage, a restrained return of the main motif, then a natural unresolved decaying ending. Patient pacing with long breathing spaces. No abrupt ending.
